name: Nuooly
headline: A membership community app for independent professionals
overview: Nuooly describes itself as an exclusive community uniting and empowering independent professionals. Techlio delivered the product end to end, from discovery and design through development, deployment and support, including its mobile app.

solutions.title: Member onboarding
solutions.text: Sign-up, login and a guided multi-step profile creation flow with profile photos and bios.

solutions.title: Memberships and payments
solutions.text: Membership plans and card payments in account settings, integrated with Braintree.

solutions.title: Community features
solutions.text: Messages, projects and alerts for members inside the app.

solutions.title: Deployment and support
solutions.text: Structured app testing before release, then ongoing fixes and improvements under a support agreement.
